name: MoGe-3 ViT-L (Microsoft), MLX port
usage: Monocular 3D geometry: metric point map, depth, surface normals and camera intrinsics from one photo

sources.note: MoGe-2 ViT-L (without the normal head) as fp16 safetensors, MIT with LICENSE and NOTICE; converted from Ruicheng/moge-2-vitl revision 39c4d5e9; 326.2 M parameters, 652,471,190 bytes, half of the official 1,305,030,700-byte fp32 model.pt (consistent); uploader is a Hugging Face diffusers team member; 42 downloads; checked 15.11.2026

licence.note: no LICENSE file in either repository; the official code is MIT

size_gb.note: fp32 safetensors; a ViT-g port is 5.00 GB

runtimes.value: mlx-vlm `moge3` (PR #2171, merged 05.09.2026; v0.7.12). The official code says "macOS is not supported" (FlexGEMM/Triton)

provenance.value: consistent: 370.3 M fp32 parameters; 1,481,204,170 bytes against 1,481,333,394 for the official model.pt (pickle overhead); converted with mlx-vlm (PR #2171, merged by a maintainer); fp32 check against PyTorch reported by the port author: identical masks, under 0.2 % median depth error
provenance.note: uploaded 02.09.2026 by an mlx-community member; no base_model in the card; 140 downloads, no discussion

web.scope: Released 18.08.2026: all comments since release. Hacker News, Hugging Face discussions (model-card PRs only), GitHub issues of microsoft/MoGe and mlx-vlm. Reddit not readable. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Edge refinement can amplify depth errors; an independent reproduction falls far short of the paper on KITTI (outdoor), better on indoor sets; one user prefers MoGe-2 normals.
web.verdict: Useful one-photo geometry on Mac via MLX; metric accuracy disputed outdoors

comments.text: "Models like MapAnything/MoGe predict calibration params directly… We still calibrate manually on-site, but mainly to validate these models actually hold up." ([HN, 09.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48465090))

"Quality is not as good as described"; the refinement "improves some edges, but it also amplifies depth errors" ([MoGe #171, 13–16.10.2026](https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe/issues/171)). Independent reproduction of ViT-L far below the paper on KITTI (δ1 55.3 against 85.1), better on NYUv2 and ETH3D; maintainers investigating ([#173, 21.10.2026](https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe/issues/173)).
Normals worse than `moge-2-vitl-normal` for one user ([#163, 03.09.2026](https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe/issues/163)).

MLX port: the reviewer says "lgtm"; under 0.2 % median depth difference against PyTorch, self-reported by the port author ([mlx-vlm PR #2171, 05.09.2026](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2171)).
